title: Position: The Complexity of Perfect AI Alignment – Formalizing the RLHF Trilemma

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical complexity-theoretic analysis formalizing the RLHF Alignment Trilemma to demonstrate the computational intractability of capturing diverse global value systems (e.g., contrasting WEIRD populations with non-Western norms).

Mathematical proofs demonstrating that achieving representativeness across varied demographic groups scales super-polynomially, forcing RLHF systems to collapse preferences toward homogeneous majority annotators.
